problem:
Problem description
- There is a single-period production planning problem for $$N$$ container types indexed by $$i,j \in \mathcal{N}=\{1,\ldots,N\}$$.
- Each container type $$i$$ is characterized by a volume parameter $$v_i$$, a demand parameter $$d_i$$, and a unit variable production cost $$c_i$$.
- Each container type has its own dedicated equipment. A fixed setup cost $$f_i$$ is incurred whenever the equipment for type $$i$$ is activated. In this instance, the setup cost is common across types.
- If a type is not produced, its equipment remains inactive and no setup cost is paid for that type.
- A produced unit of type $$i$$ may be used to satisfy demand for type $$j$$ only when the volume of type $$i$$ is not smaller than the volume of type $$j$$.
- Because the types are ordered by nondecreasing volume, larger-volume types may substitute for smaller-volume types, but not the other way around.
- All demand must be fully met after allowing such substitutions among compatible types.
- If an external production limit is provided, $$K_i$$ denotes the capacity of type $$i$$; otherwise, no separate capacity limit is specified beyond the demand and substitution rules.
- The planning goal is to minimize the total cost over the single planning horizon $$\mathcal{T}=\{1\}$$, combining all unit production costs and all setup costs.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$q_i$$: the total quantity produced of container type $$i$$.
  - $$y_i$$: a binary activation indicator for the equipment of type $$i$$, where $$y_i=1$$ means the equipment is activated.
  - $$x_{i,j}$$: the quantity produced as type $$i$$ and assigned to satisfy demand of type $$j$$, defined only for compatible pairs.
  - $$Z$$: the minimized total cost of the production plan.

Input Format
{
  "N": "integer, number of container types $$N$$",
  "T": "single-period planning horizon $$\mathcal{T}=\{1\}$$",
  "v": "array of length $$N$$; $$v_i$$ is the volume of container type $$i$$, with indices ordered so that volumes are nondecreasing",
  "d": "array of length $$N$$; $$d_i$$ is the demand for container type $$i$$",
  "c": "array of length $$N$$; $$c_i$$ is the unit variable production cost for container type $$i$$",
  "f": "scalar; common fixed setup cost incurred when a type's equipment is activated",
  "K": "optional array of length $$N$$; $$K_i$$ is the production capacity of type $$i$$ if a capacity limit is supplied",
  "compatibility_rule": "type $$i$$ may satisfy demand of type $$j$$ only when $$v_i \\ge v_j$$"
}

Output Format
{
  "Z": "scalar, minimized total cost",
  "q": "array of length $$N$$; $$q_i$$ is the total quantity produced of container type $$i$$",
  "y": "binary array of length $$N$$; $$y_i$$ indicates whether the equipment for type $$i$$ is activated",
  "x": "matrix of shape $$N \\times N$$; $$x_{i,j}$$ is the quantity produced as type $$i$$ and used to meet demand of type $$j$$, defined only for compatible pairs"
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "N": 6,
  "T": 1,
  "v": [1500, 2500, 4000, 6000, 9000, 12000],
  "d": [500, 550, 700, 900, 400, 300],
  "c": [5, 8, 10, 12, 16, 18],
  "f": 1200
}

parameters.name: num_container_types
parameters.description: Number of container types in the single-period production planning problem

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Single planning horizon containing one period

parameters.name: common_setup_cost
parameters.description: Common fixed setup cost incurred when a type is activated, if provided

parameters.name: unit_production_costs
parameters.description: Unit production cost of each container type

parameters.name: capacity_limits
parameters.description: Optional production capacity limit for each container type

variables.name: total_production
variables.description: Total quantity produced of each container type

variables.name: activation_indicator
variables.description: Binary activation indicator for the equipment of each container type

variables.name: assignment_quantity
variables.description: Quantity produced as type i and assigned to satisfy demand of type j for compatible type pairs

variables.name: total_cost
variables.description: Minimized total cost over the single planning period

auxiliary_variables.name: compatibility_mask
auxiliary_variables.description: Binary mask equal to 1 when production type i can satisfy demand type j, i.e., when v[i] \ge v[j], and 0 otherwise; fixed exogenously by the known volume ordering.

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_production
constraints.description: Total production quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: binary_activation
constraints.description: Equipment activation indicators must be binary

constraints.name: nonnegative_assignment_quantity
constraints.description: Compatible assignment quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: demand_fulfillment
constraints.description: All demand must be fully satisfied through compatible production assignments

constraints.name: compatibility_rule
constraints.description: Assignments are allowed only from producing type i to demand type j when the producing type volume is at least the demanded type volume

constraints.name: activation_setup_link
constraints.description: Producing a type activates its equipment and incurs the fixed setup cost; inactive equipment incurs no setup cost

constraints.name: capacity_limit_if_provided
constraints.description: If capacity limits are provided, total production of each type cannot exceed its capacity

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_production_bounds
constraints.description: Total production quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: activation_binary_domain
constraints.description: Equipment activation indicators must be binary

constraints.name: nonnegative_assignment_quantities
constraints.description: Assignment quantities must be nonnegative for all compatible type pairs

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: Total cost equals production costs plus setup costs

constraints.name: demand_fulfillment_constraint
constraints.description: All demand must be fully satisfied through compatible production assignments

constraints.name: production_definition
constraints.description: Total production of each type equals the sum of compatible assignments produced as that type

constraints.name: compatibility_fix_incompatible_pairs
constraints.description: Incompatible assignments are fixed to zero and compatible pairs are left unrestricted by this rule; compatibility is determined by the known volume ordering.

constraints.name: activation_production_link
constraints.description: Producing a type activates its equipment; total production is bounded by a finite big-M derived from demand totals when no explicit capacity is available.

constraints.name: capacity_limit_if_provided_constraint
constraints.description: If capacity limits are provided, total production of each type cannot exceed its capacity.

objectives.name: total_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total single-period production and setup cost over the planning horizon

final_objective.description: Minimize the total single-period cost, consisting of unit production costs and common setup costs for activated types.
